coaching.headline: All five lanes read ours and the film agrees — and we still lost 12-31, because they traded fights for objectives and we traded objectives for fights.
coaching.team: The lane sheet was a sweep: every verdict ours. The map told the real story — three times (13.1, 17.1, 19.7) we won or drew the bodies while they took Fangtooth, Mini Prime and Orb Prime across the map, and our seven won fights cashed only three. The 17.9 fight was the hinge: a full 5v5 at their outer tower, lost 0-5. Winning lanes is the setup; the win is spending them on the objective before the enemy spends theirs.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 17.9-minute 0-5 wipe at their outer tower, bracketed by their cross-map objective trades — Fangtooth at 15, Mini Prime at 17.2, Orb at 22.2 — each bought while we were winning a fight somewhere else.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: The Fey won mid wire to wire, and the macro names the cost of staying there: five separate fights (2.7, 7.8, 14.6, 17.1, 23.3) where mid was alive and ahead while the team fought short-handed. A winning Fey is the rotation engine — shove the wave, arrive, and the 0-2s and 0-3s become even fights. The five deaths were affordable; the absences were not.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Kallari won the jungle and put up 10 kills with 26k objective damage — and 11 deaths. Two were solo catches while rotating (8.7, 9.9), and the film prices the rest: the 13.6 death preceded their Fangtooth, 19.1 the inner tower, 31.9 the Orb at 32.3. On a squishy assassin the exits matter as much as the entries; leave before the collapse.

ability.name: Windburn
ability.what: Passive: Every third successful consecutive basic attack will deal 2/2.5/3/3.5/4% of the target’s maximum health as bonus physical damage and heals Yin for +(10/12/14/16/18%) Health.

loadout.plain: Windburn lasts a bit longer and your hits heal you based on missing health while it is active. Turn it on when the fight gets close to sustain through long trades.

loadout.text: Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).
loadout.plain: Your basic attacks mark the target, so you deal more to them and take less back. Helps in long duels where you keep hitting one hero.

loadout.name: Ferocity
loadout.text: Gain 1% Total Attack Speed per 1s in Hero Combat, stacking infinitely.
loadout.plain: Attack speed that keeps climbing the longer you stay in hero combat. Stacks with Rising Storm in long fights.

loadout.text: Purifying Guard:  Cleanse all Debuffs. Gain a 80 (+100%) Shield for 2.5s.
loadout.plain: Removes crowd control and gives a short shield. Use it when stunned or slowed so you can keep attacking and hold your Rising Storm stacks.
